scope: Historical local dev31 verification before source integration and browser acceptance; not final PR acceptance.
not_run: Live or paid provider calls and summarization quality evaluation
Native Windows and real browser/Edge acceptance

semantics.summary_calls: Same selected profile, charged to ordinary logical call/time budgets; not a monetary cap
semantics.token_estimate: Optional per-profile planning budget; UTF-8-byte heuristic plus output/reserve, not a tokenizer or fit guarantee
semantics.old_authority: summary is untrusted; reread cited retained human source or ask when missing
semantics.protocol: Complete native assistant/tool-result groups retained or removed together
semantics.limits: Lossy summaries, bounded original eviction, explicit no-progress/failure/cancellation and budget stops
